title: Yara and the Colony Revisited
author: Ivo Ishikawa
blurb: Ada Sandoval, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the jump window closes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
